verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents narrow, product-native rule-driven automation. AI Object Storage bucket lifecycle policies apply defined actions (Expiration, NoncurrentVersionExpiration, AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload), and the Cluster Autoscaler scales Node Pools in response to workload demand. Neither amounts to a general user-defined event→action rules engine. missing for 10: general-purpose event-triggered rule definitions, documented event sources and triggers, configurable custom actions, alert-to-action automation, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Bucket lifecycle policies is the reference for supported lifecycle actions (Expiration, NoncurrentVersionExpiration, AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload)
letting you scale CKS Node Pools in response to workload demands for GPU, CPU, or memory resources
